description: Roles and scopes are defined per realm (beyond admin/user); definitions are owned here and emitted as claims, with enforcement delegated to RPs.

requirements.description: Beyond the built-in admin/user roles, each realm must support custom role and scope definitions (name, description, permissions). Roles are assigned to users within a realm; scopes are requested by clients. Issued tokens carry roles and scopes as claims. Enforcement of scope-based access control is delegated to relying parties using the claims; the authenticator's responsibility is correct definition, assignment, and emission.
requirements.title: Per-Realm Roles and Scopes RBAC with Claims Emission
